title: ALMA Observations of the Molecular Clouds in NGC 625
question: What are the global and cloud-scale properties of the molecular gas in the dwarf starburst NGC 625, and how do the clouds relate to HII regions and star formation?

what.value: HII region sizes and Halpha SFR comparison/stellar populations

evidence.quote: assuming the sizes of these regions as determined by (cite: Cannon_2003)
a molecular gas mass of $(5.0\pm0.7)\times10^6$ $M_\odot$, assuming a Galactic conversion factor
following the reddening $E(B-V)=0.16$ mag reported by (cite: Schlegel_1998)

recipe.goal: Image the CO cube and continuum
recipe.method: Multiscale CLEAN with natural weighting, masked, continuum subtracted, primary-beam corrected; tapered cubes for flux recovery

recipe.goal: Global CO spectrum and molecular mass
recipe.method: Average brightness temperature per channel, fit a Gaussian, convert luminosity to mass with Galactic alpha_CO
CPROPS with CLUMPFIND modification, extrapolation to 0 K, beam/channel deconvolution, 50 bootstraps
key_parameters: t=4, e=2, 15 pc x 15 pc x 2 km/s search box, EDGE=2
assumptions: Mvir=1040 R sigma_v^2, spherical clouds with rho ~ R^-1; Milky Way alpha_CO

recipe.method: Spearman rank correlation and BCES fits of size-linewidth, C-Sigma, Mvir-Mlum, mass-size

recipe.goal: Halpha SFR map and extinction correction
recipe.method: HST Halpha continuum-subtracted, corrected for Galactic extinction and Balmer decrement, converted with Kennicutt & Evans relation
assumptions: Case B, T=10,000 K, ne=100 cm^-3, Halpha/Hbeta=2.86; SFR constant over 10 Myr

recipe.method: tau_dep = M_H2/SFR globally and in HII regions A-D, Butterfly, Serpent
key_parameters: upper limit SFR <~5e-4 Msun/yr for Butterfly and Serpent
assumptions: Galactic alpha_CO; possibly higher (3x, ~9x with metallicity scaling)

evidence.quote: corresponds to a total molecular mass of $(5.34\pm0.34)\times 10^6$ $M_\odot$
the luminosity of this region is $1.2\times10^6$ K km s$^{-1}$ pc$^2$
we catalog 33 clouds. Fourteen clouds have deconvolved radii smaller than the telescope beam

not_stated_but_needed: Multiscale scales, cell/image size in pixels, number of CLEAN iterations and threshold
Line-free channels used for continuum subtraction
Flux scale uncertainty and calibrator flux values
Whether archive-delivered or reprocessed calibrated data were used
CPROPS settings beyond defaults (e.g. exact masks, MAXPEAK/fudge values)
Halpha flux values/aperture definitions for regions A-D and the Butterfly/Serpent boundaries
score_reason: Public ALMA data and stated cloud-finding recipe, but imaging parameters and the Halpha SFR steps are only partly specified.
rediscovery_reason: Data are public, the CPROPS recipe is largely stated, and the main results are numeric (mass, cloud medians, scaling fits).
